rejected.why: §33.9 places fs-adjoint in group `structure`, for structural sensitivities reached by frob-foundry, and nothing in the plan routes it to frob-synth: §25.21.2 only records as a FACT that the module exists, takes the gradients with respect to design parameters from the derived kernels of §21, and BD-362 computes the sensitivity of the optimal cost by the envelope derivative ∂L/∂θ, one gradient evaluation with no implicit-function solve. If a lane ever needs one, fs-ad::ift is on the bedrock-direct list (§33.3) and is admitted by INT-FSIM-10 (§33.10). Moving or sharing fs-adjoint would contradict §33.9. The real residue of the report, that frob-synth is not on the consumer list of `optimize` for the fs-ascent solvers, is closed by row 1 of ADR-SUITE-03 in N33bx-02, which also plants `frob-synth requests structure` as a failing control; the adapter is N33a-31, already a dependency of BD-362 and N25d-13
